idea: Explain why popcorn pops, and why a few kernels in every bowl never do, through the kernels themselves changing on screen rather than a labelled machine.
audience: curious adults and teens scrolling short vertical video
intended_effect: a satisfying 'oh, that's why' about the unpopped kernels at the bottom of the bowl, plus one surprising fact about the pop sound
style: a print-made science look that is not Motif's paper-robot style

references.note: Virot & Ponomarenko (2015), Popcorn: critical temperature, jump and sound, J. R. Soc. Interface 12: 20141247
Hoseney, Zeleznak & Abdelrahman (1983), Mechanism of popcorn popping, J. Cereal Sci. 1: 43-52

constraints: Every consequential spoken claim maps to a source in the claim ledger.
No on-screen character mascot; the kernels carry the story.
